formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (x1 : ℕ) (x2 : SimpleGraph (Fin x1)) [x3 : DecidableRel x2.Adj] (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ (x5 x6 x7 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x5 x6 → x2.Adj x6 x7 → ¬x2.Adj x7 x5) → (∀ (x6 x7 x8 x9 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x6 x7 → x2.Adj x7 x8 → x2.Adj x8 x9 → x2.Adj x9 x6 → x6 = x8 ∨ x7 = x9) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x4 → (∀ (x8 : Fin x1 → Bool), x4.eval (List.ofFn x8) = Decidable.decide (∃ (x9 : Fin x1) (x10 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x9 x10 ∧ x8 x9 = Bool.true ∧ x8 x10 = Bool.true)) → (∀ (x9 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x9 → (∀ (x11 : Fin x1 → Bool), x9.eval (List.ofFn x11) = Decidable.decide (∃ (x12 : Fin x1) (x13 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x12 x13 ∧ x11 x12 = Bool.true ∧ x11 x13 = Bool.true)) → x4.size ≤ x9.size) → (∀ (x10 : ℕ) (x11 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), x4.gates[x10]? = Option.some x11 → x11.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ∀ (x14 : Fin x1 → Bool), (x4.wires (List.ofFn x14)).getD (x1 + x10) Bool.false = Bool.true → ∃ (x16 : Fin x1) (x17 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x16 x17 ∧ x14 x16 = Bool.true ∧ x14 x17 = Bool.true) → ∃ (x11 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x11 ∧ x11.size ≤ x4.size ∧ (∀ (x12 : Fin x1 → Bool), x11.eval (List.ofFn x12) = Decidable.decide (∃ (x13 : Fin x1) (x14 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x13 x14 ∧ x12 x13 = Bool.true ∧ x12 x14 = Bool.true)) ∧ ∀ (x12 : ℕ) (x13 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), x11.gates[x12]? = Option.some x13 → x13.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → (∀ (x16 : Fin x1 → Bool), (x11.wires (List.ofFn x16)).getD (x1 + x12) Bool.false = Bool.true → ∃ (x18 : Fin x1) (x19 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x18 x19 ∧ x16 x18 = Bool.true ∧ x16 x19 = Bool.true) ∧ ∃ (x16 : Fin x1) (x17 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x16 x17 ∧ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.Owns x1 x11 x12 x16 x17)
plain_statement: It is false that: A graph with no triangle and no 4-cycle; C a least circuit of AND and OR gates, at most two inputs a gate, for its edge function, every AND gate true only where the function is true. Then some such circuit for the function, no larger than C, has every AND gate true only where the function is true and owning at least one edge.
title: It is false that: A step toward: On graphs with no triangle and no 4-cycle, some least AND/OR circuit of fan-in two for the edge function has every AND gate own
